segments.name: Protein Sciences
segments.description: Develops and manufactures biological reagents and proteomic analytical tools for life science research, diagnostics, and cell and gene therapy customers.
segments.evidence: Our Protein Sciences segment is a leading developer and manufacturer of high-quality biological reagents used in all aspects of life science research, diagnostics and cell and gene therapy.

segments.name: Diagnostics and Spatial Biology
segments.description: Develops and manufactures diagnostic controls, assays, spatial biology instruments, and genetic and oncology kits for diagnostic and research markets.
segments.evidence: Our Diagnostics and Spatial Biology segment develops and manufactures diagnostic products, including controls, calibrators, and diagnostic assays for the regulated diagnostics market, advanced tissue-based in-situ hybridization assays and instrumentation for spatial genomic and tissue biopsy analysis, and genetic and oncology kits for research and clinical applications.

revenueModel.text: Bio-Techne earns net sales from selling life science reagents, instruments and services directly to researchers, pharmaceutical and biotech companies, diagnostic makers, and via OEM and distribution agreements.
revenueModel.evidence: Bio-Techne and its subsidiaries, collectively doing business as Bio-Techne Corporation ("Bio-Techne", "we", "our", "us" or the "Company"), develop, manufacture and sell life science reagents, instruments and services for the research, diagnostics and bioprocessing markets worldwide.

changes.text: In fiscal 2024, the company acquired Lunaphore SA, adding automated spatial biology solutions to the Diagnostics and Spatial Biology segment.
changes.evidence: A recent example includes the acquisition of Lunaphore SA ("Lunaphore") at the beginning of fiscal 2024.
